paragraphs: Rav Tahlifa of Caesarea: Jerusalem Talmud, end of Rosh Hashanah; beginning of Seder Ta'anit; end of Sotah, chapter 5; Devarim Rabbah, section 1. In R' Pila's name: Rabbah, Be-Shallah, section 24. In R' Shimon ben Levi's name: Yalkut Shir ha-Shirim, at “Your lips drip honey,” and Tanhuma. Perhaps he is Halafta of Caesarea; see his entry.
